audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven rows read Skill in both layers, including 2+ items, while the page's own late text says the 33% lives there.
audit.why: The packet defect (a chart handing Lucian four stages) is already gone from the shipped text, but the flat all-Skill chart still overstates the late game against a lethality scaler with a low-cooldown Heroic Swing reset.
audit.corrected: Row 6 flipped to Akshan in both layers with the rating pulled to 3/10; rows 0-5 left as Skill, which the whys support.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item carried boilerplate about The Culling's lane clear and a Lucian kill window.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70s and scales on missing health; Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and falls to 12s, which is what actually gates every commit.
audit.corrected: Both rows now name the real cooldowns and say what opens a window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither Dirty Fighting's shield nor the Ardent Blaze reveal versus Going Rogue reached the page (packet also flagged that no Akshan ability was named — the shipped text now names Heroic Swing but nothing else).
audit.why: Dirty Fighting shields Akshan on every third hit from his attacks and abilities against a champion, so it eats the front of a double-shot string. Ardent Blaze reveals, which answers Going Rogue's camouflage — the mirror slice states the same interaction from Akshan's side.
audit.corrected: Shield-baiting added to the don'ts, the reveal added to the key-interactions block.

edits.after: Comeuppance (100s) scales on missing health and his revive resets fights — trade for tempo, not the all-in.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: His lethality, Q kite and a 12s Heroic Swing out-scale a weak ADC-top — take plates and be useful on the map instead.

edits.before: That is Akshan’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.

edits.before: Track Akshan’s Heroic Swing: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Heroic Swing (18s): bait the swing, then W-mark — Ardent Blaze reveals him through Going Rogue's camouflage.
